project_metadata.job_description: I recently received AI-generated artwork (3 illustrations) from an illustrator. I was disappointed by their plagiarized work. Looking for an artist who can complete the project by giving these concepts/illustrations final touches without using AI tools. Please reach out for more information if interested. Happy to share AI-artwork before offering contract.
